content: As a first validation step, we extracted fixation-related potentials (FRPs), where the EEG signal during all fixations of one task are averaged. Figure FIGREF24 shows the time-series of the resulting FRPs for two electrodes (PO8 and Cz), as well as topographies of the voltage distributions across the scalp at selected points in time. The five components (for which the scalp topographies are plotted) are highly similar in the time-course of the chosen electrodes to dimigen2011coregistration as well as to ZuCo 1.0.
